name: Koodo Reader
author: Troye
description: Koodo Reader is an all-in-one eBook reader for Windows, macOS, Linux, and the web, supporting over 15 formats.

versions.release_notes:
New Features
- Added OCR plugin functionality; go to Settings > Plugins
- Added support for the following file formats: caj, djvu, xps, chm, doc, rtf, pptx, ppt, ofd, djv, oxps, and ofd
- The reading page now supports an immersive title bar, which automatically hides while reading
- Reading options now support grouped display
- Added book collections and grouping features, allowing you to combine and manage multiple books together
- Support for adjusting page spacing in double-page view; go to Reading Options on the right > Layout
- Support for right-to-left page turning; go to Reading Options on the right > Layout
- Support for exporting book packages: Book files, along with notes, highlights, bookmarks, and dictionary history, are bundled into a single new file for easy sharing with others or importing onto new devices
- Added a prompt asking whether to clear all data upon uninstallation
- Support for parsing ISBN, publication date, modification date, language, and other information from book files
- Optimized for comics in EPUB, MOBI, and AZW3 formats, with support for double-page mode and continuous scrolling
- Added an auto-read feature that automatically scrolls pages at a specified speed; tap the “Assisted Reading” button in the top-right corner
- Added options to clear temporary cache and TTS cache; go to Settings > Data
- Added a pop-up prompt before opening external links
- Support for hiding the built-in background in text-only PDFs
- Support for clearing all keyboard shortcuts
- Optimized chapter division rules for TXT files
- (Mobile) Reading settings are divided into Basic Settings and Advanced Settings; Advanced Settings now support grouped display
- (Mobile) Added support for MEGA cloud storage
- (Mobile) Added an option to automatically adjust reading brightness
- (Mobile) The native PDF reader and comic reader now support page turning via volume keys
- (Mobile) Added Data Management to Settings, which displays cache and total data sizes
- (Mobile) Added support for adjusting the threshold for automatically clearing temporary cache; go to Settings > Data Management
- (Mobile) Added support for clearing the TTS cache; go to Settings > Data Management
- (Mobile) Added an overlay animation for page-turning
- (Mobile) Sorting by book title now supports sorting by numerical order
- (Mobile) Added support for djvu, xps, chm, doc, rtf, pptx, ppt, ofd, djv, oxps, and ofd file formats
- (Mobile) Added book collections and grouping features, allowing you to merge and manage multiple books together
- (Mobile) Added support for adjusting page spacing in two-page view. Please click the setting button in the reading page
- (Mobile) Added support for right-to-left page turning. Please click the setting button in the reading page
- (Mobile) Added support for parsing ISBN, publication date, modification date, language, and other information from book files
- (Mobile) Optimized support for comics in EPUB, MOBI, and AZW3 formats, with support for double-page mode and continuous scrolling
- (Mobile) Added support for hiding the built-in background in text-only PDFs
- (Mobile) Optimized chapter division rules for TXT files
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where content in some books was obscured in both single-page and two-page modes
- Fixed import and rendering issues for some CBZ and CBR format books
- Fixed an issue where some AI providers could not retrieve the model list
- Fixed a security vulnerability in directory traversal for the Docker version of OPDS
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where audiobooks could not be played in the background for extended periods after the screen was locked (Mobile) Fixed an issue where the bookmark list in the native PDF reader and comic reader was empty
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where the scope of text rules could not be set
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where content in some books was obscured in single-page and double-page modes
- (Mobile) Fixed import and rendering issues for some CBZ and CBR format books
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where some AI providers could not retrieve the model list
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.

New Features
- The table of content now displays the number of pages by default; there is no need to enable the “Total Pages” feature separately.
- Software security has been optimized to address an arbitrary code execution vulnerability caused by metadata.
- An additional confirmation step has been added when importing books via external links using the URL scheme to enhance security.
- The “Ask AI” feature now supports the Ctrl + Enter shortcut for submitting questions.
- Added an eraser tool to Doodle Mode
- Added support for 7 languages on the official website
- (Mobile) Added a feature to resync all book covers; go to Settings > Sync options
- (Mobile) Optimized the smoothness of page-turning animations
- (Mobile) Optimized the smoothness of certain app animations
- (Mobile) Added an option to download images in CBZ comic mode
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where footnotes in some books did not appear in a pop-up window
- Fixed an issue where reading progress could not be tracked for some books containing special styles
- Fixed an issue where table of contents highlighting did not work after enabling “Total Pages”
- Fixed an issue where page numbers were not displayed in the table of contents for some TXT books
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where authorization via the browser failed on older iOS versions, resulting in a blank page
- (Mobile Version) Fixed abnormal slider behavior on iOS
- (Mobile Version) Fixed an issue where swiping on an image triggered image preview in scroll mode
- (Mobile Version) Fixed an issue where text could not be selected in the Android version after enabling recommended layout under certain conditions
- (Mobile Version) Fixed stuttering issues when enabling TTS for some book
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue on iOS where the horizontal bar in the bottom navigation bar did not automatically hide during reading
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where footnotes for some books did not appear in a pop-up window
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where reading progress could not be tracked for some books containing special styles
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where page numbers were not displayed on the table of contents for some TXT books
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.

New Features
- Support for exporting notes, highlights, and new vocabulary in JSON format
- Support for re-importing notes, highlights, and new vocabulary in JSON and CSV formats; go to Settings > Data
- Optimized rendering speed when handling large numbers of notes and highlights; no more lag issues
- Support for using AI to extract book titles and author names from filenames; right-click on a book and select “Edit Book”
- Support for using AI to parse book titles and authors from filenames when importing books; go to Settings > General
- Supports caching full-text translation and OCR results; books will load directly from the cache the next time they’re opened
- Added Paragraph Mode, Reading Ruler, and Speed Reading Mode; enable them in the reading options panel on the right
- Supports streaming parsing of CBZ and CBT books; no longer requires loading the entire book into memory, significantly improving book import and opening speeds
- Online book metadata matching now includes publication date, ISBN, ratings, and other information
- Copying text from books now preserves the original text formatting
- Added 100 curated book and app background images; go to Settings > Background Images
- Added 11 public domain dictionaries; go to Settings > Local Dictionaries
- Added export progress tracking for batch book exports
- Supports searching for books using a book key
- Restored support for custom TTS plugins, with added security warnings
- Experimental support for total page count; enable this in the reading options panel on the right
- Added page number display to the book table of contents, please enable total page count first
- The official AI dictionary now supports more target languages
- Added a “Return” button after navigating to a section via the inb-book table of contents
- (Mobile) The iOS version now supports accessing the system dictionary, system translation, and system OCR; go to Settings > Third-Party Services
- (Mobile) Optimized import and opening speeds for large CBZ files
- (Mobile) Added a dedicated comic mode for CBZ format, supporting streaming rendering
- (Mobile) Added support for batch downloading books; tap the three dots at the top of the home screen and select “Batch Operations”
- (Mobile) Optimized the chart UI for reading statistics
- (Mobile) Support for custom translation and TTS APIs; go to Settings > API Settings
- (Mobile) Added a “Return” button after navigating to a section via the in-book table of contents
- (Mobile) Expanded the font size adjustment range
- (Mobile) Support for adjusting the paragraph spacing threshold and title size threshold for text-based PDFs when converting to texts
- (Mobile) Optimized rendering speed for books with extensive notes and highlights; stuttering issues have been resolved
- (Mobile) Support for using AI to extract book titles and author names from filenames; long-press a book and select “Edit”
- (Mobile) Support for using AI to extract book titles and author names from filenames when importing books; go to Settings > General Options
- (Mobile) Support for caching full-text translation and OCR results; books will be loaded directly from the cache the next time they are opened
- (Mobile) Added Paragraph Mode, Reading Ruler, and Speed Reading Mode; enable these in Settings on the book page
- (Mobile) Online book metadata matching now includes publication date, ISBN, ratings, and other information
- (Mobile) Added 100 curated book background images
- (Mobile) Support for searching books using a book key
- (Mobile) Experimental support for total page count; go to Settings > Reading Options
- (Mobile) Page numbers are now displayed in the book table of contents, please enable total page count first
- (Mobile) The official AI dictionary now supports more target languages
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where word pronunciations did not match after pinning the dictionary window to the right
- Fixed an issue where deletion and replacement rules did not work for TTS
- Fixed an issue where books could not be imported from the cloud
- Fixed an issue where double-clicking a book in a folder to import it did not work
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where custom fonts did not take effect in certain cases
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where the Back button did not work in certain cases on Android
- (Mobile) Fixed a font size issue on iOS in landscape mode
- (Mobile) Fixed PDF rendering issues in two-page mode
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where deletion and replacement rules did not work for TTS
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.

New Features
- The bookmarks, notes, and highlights lists in the left panel now support searching and sorting by reading progress
- Supports automatic import of books from local folders. Click the triangle next to the “Import” button. Each time the app launches, it will automatically scan the specified folder for new books and import them
- Added the total number of search results to the in-book search feature
- Added highlight rules to text rules, allowing you to highlight specific text within a book
- Improved software security: Sandbox environment and context isolation are enabled by default, and the rendering process’s permissions to access and manipulate the local machine have been disabled. Due to this change, custom TTS plugins will no longer be supported
- Optimized memory usage during book import
- The Translation, Dictionary, Ask AI, and Notes popups can now be moved to any position or pinned to the right side to function as a sidebar
- Support for clearing AI chat history
- Support for configuring HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies; go to Settings > More Settings
- Scanned PDFs now support more annotation styles, including highlighters, text, shapes, and more
- Support for copying AI chat responses; tap the “Copy” button at the bottom of the response
- Optimized the PDF TTS feature to support more natural sentence breaks
- OPDS now supports downloading books in more formats
- (Mobile) Optimized performance and frame rate for smooth and simulated page-turning animations
- (Mobile) Adapted to the iOS 26 Liquid Glass effect
- (Mobile) The iOS version now supports importing folders
- (Mobile) Supports custom app icons; go to Settings > Appearance
- (Mobile) The Android APK version now supports scanning all books on the device
- (Mobile) The Android APK version now supports automatically importing all books from a specified folder
- (Mobile) The app now supports 10 additional languages
- (Mobile) Added highlight rule feature to text rules, allowing you to highlight specific text in books
- (Mobile) Added support for clearing chat history in AI chat
- (Mobile) Optimized the TTS feature for PDFs, supporting more natural sentence breaks
- (Mobile) Optimized error messages for the sync feature
- (Mobile) Optimized the list performance of AI chat; now only the last three rounds of conversations are displayed by default
- (Mobile) Upgraded to the new React Native architecture to improve overall app performance
- (Mobile) Automatically keeps the screen on during synchronization to prevent interruptions caused by the screen locking
Fixes
- Fixed an issue with footnote display in certain books
- Fixed a memory leak when exporting books or backing up the book library
- Fixed an issue where text at the bottom of the screen was obscured when full-text translation and new word definitions were enabled in scroll mode
- Fixed styling issues with tables within books
- Fixed an issue where the right-click menu on a book was obscured by the window edge
- Fixed an issue where certain CBR comics could not be imported
- Fixed an issue where the download progress bar obscured the settings button
- Fixed a blank screen issue when opening a book after deleting a custom TXT parser
- Fixed compatibility issues with custom AI models for certain model providers and models
- Fixed an issue where OPDS could not load more than 20 books
- Expanded the font size adjustment range
- (Mobile) Fixed blurry text when zooming in on PDFs on Android
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where books in subfolders could not be imported
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue with the display of footnotes in some books
- (Mobile) Fixed a styling issue with tables in books
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where text at the bottom was obscured in scroll mode after enabling full-text translation and new word definitions
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where some CBR comics could not be imported
- (Mobile) Fixed compatibility issues with custom AI models for certain model providers and models
- (Mobile) Fixed abnormalities in the audiobook feature under certain conditions
- (Mobile) Fixed styling issues with AI Book Q&A in Dark Mode
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue on iOS where the system menu obscured selected text
- (Mobile) Fixed crashes that occurred in some cases while reading PDFs on iOS
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where table of contents navigation did not work for some PDF books
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where verification codes could not be entered on iPad in certain situations
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where selecting text on iPad would cause the page to turn unintentionally
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue with abnormal download progress when downloading multiple books simultaneously; now limited to downloading only one book at a time
Note
This version has been selected as the stable release candidate. It should work fine in most cases. If you have any concerns, please download the previous stable version
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.

New Features
- The context length for custom AI models now retains approximately 5 messages by default to prevent the context from growing indefinitely
- The keyboard shortcut for creating a note has been changed to Ctrl + Enter
- Optimize the trigger area for the buttons around the book
- Browser extension is now listed in the Chrome Web Store and Edge Addons Store
- (Mobile) The context length for custom AI models now retains approximately 5 messages by default to prevent the context from growing indefinitely
- (Mobile) Android version is now listed in the Google Play Store
Fixes
- Fixed an issue where backup files from the 1.7.4 stable release could not be restored
- Fixed an issue where PDF reading progress was lost in the 1.7.4 stable release
- Fixed an issue where the book list was not displayed after upgrading from the 1.7.4 stable release
- Fixed compatibility issues with the Minimax audiobook plugin
- (Mobile) Fixed a UI issue on the TTS voice page
Note
This version has been selected as the stable release candidate. It should work fine in most cases. If you have any concerns, please download the previous stable version
Tip
You can also download the installation package for this version from the our self-hosted mirror.

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
